notes.notes:

On the other hand, there're some cases were the game freezes during the loading screen because you're trying to load a saved game from an old version (v1.1.2 or earlier). Send me the most recent files you see there (or just all of them), I will check them and then send you back the ones fixed. Email: contact@hellboundgame.com

Click on the images to see the originals in high definition, and let's follow the guy and his outstanding work at his new Twitter account. Besides Hellbound, he takes great shoots from other games as well.

notes.title: Build update v1.1.3 ⚙️
notes.notes:
An update on a Wednesday afternoon? Hell yeah!

How are you, demonic creatures from the depths of Hell! ? 😈


During the last months we have been working with our friends at 3ogs (Pablo and Mauricio Navajas) and with our talented art director Viktor Ahmed, to bring you that thing you've been asking for a long time...

STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/836c01528b870b7143edfef12b01e861416f4264.jpg


I also recreated the language system entirely, and added (finally) our own natal-Argentinian Spanish option. And a bunch of other fixes and improvements have been made to the game. Check out the entire list on the bottom of this post 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/277c7450886c72224644c827286778db68ded6d3.jpg


I want to take this opportunity to share with you our last Kickstarter update, where I did a recap about all the things we have accomplished together during the last years: Don't miss it, here's the link!

As I mentioned in that post, I want to start working on a new project next month.

Hellbound has been without a doubt an incredible journey for us at Saibot Studios. But unfortunately, we haven't seen a single sale from it, since the third party investment was never recouped. So this right here is probably our last update, or at least for now.


You can follow us on our social networks to stay in touch with us and to keep updated on new things to come: Twitter, Facebook, Instagram and You Tube.


Once again, I want to thank you all who have been supporting us during this time. This has been a wonderful era in our careers, with a ton of anecdotes and experiences to share ✊

And now... Let's get those freaking achievements unlocked!

Tobías

----

 Achievement system

Bug fixes:

notes.title: 🔥 Hellbound: Flying Souls Update (v1.1.1) 🔥
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/506333d226fbc95ee57883f6635f105a22a35b8c.jpg

Major Update: Flying Souls (v1.1.1) 🌋

HELLo, soldiers of Hell! How have you been?

We’ve been in overdrive preparing things for the end of the year and have some explosive new stuff for you! Are you ready? Check this out!

https://youtu.be/1Jc_yza1upM
Since we released the update in August, at Saibot Studios we have been working non-stop fixing bugs, improving the game in general, and at the same time creating new content. So we bring you...


Flying Souls: The true new level 5 of the campaign. The most complex and varied scenario of all: with indoor and outdoor confrontations and with the highest amount of secrets: 10 (SPOILER: 3 of which are almost-impossible and combined); and aesthetically SHOCKING: a floating island in the clouds, with two huge rings rotating around it.

Pygon: a completely new enemy that’s different from all the rest. It flies, spits energy balls that deal area damage, and teleports to dodge your attacks. We also added this creature to the next levels, so we recommend re-playing them as well.

Ground Zero: We recreated the classic Survival Mode scenario that we launched back in 2018 in the new version of the game, and we included it both in the original game (optional) and in the campaign. Among many other improvements compared to the classic, the new one has high-quality textures, new and improved 3D models, character ragdolls, bloodstains on the stage, new animations and visual effects for weapons, remastered music, Hellgore character voices, and much more!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/bff2bb193701adc63fef2e5570d1d716da91a00c.jpg

Doing all this was an investment that was not in the plans. Our Publisher Nimble Giant supported our development until the August release and we are grateful for that. Although both teams were very proud of the product we achieved, the sales results were not as expected.

We at Saibot then decided to go one step further and invest what little money we had left to continue improving and expanding the game, thus giving Hellbound the closure it deserves. Unfortunately, we are far from the game recouping its investment or for us to see any revenue in sales and thus be able to continue expanding the game even more.

That is why this update that we bring you today is a gift for all of you who have been supporting us, so that you can enjoy even a little more of this crazy project that was so important to us. It won't be as big a gameplay extension as you expected, but this is because our vision (commercially flawed probably) was always focused on making a small, high-quality product in all aspects of the game by adding tons of handcrafted details in each scene, enemy, item, weapon, etc. That was always our main objective; in addition to (of course) invoking the spirit of the classic FPS that we are so passionate about.

Each level of the campaign took us between 3 and 4 months of hard work, with an incredible development team of 6 people (of which only 4 were full time). The levels are built by hand, without any type of pattern or modular objects like tiles. This makes everything look more varied and organic, which was what we wanted; instead of repeated and simple.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4466206/50bf5b35fe32b20ece8bb66d579ebf92350fbdc9.jpg

We’re taking this update as an opportunity to say goodbye to Saibot's current team as we will not be in a financial position to continue supporting the team until further notice. Next year a new phase will begin for everyone, with new journeys, opportunities and new projects.

Thanks again to everyone who supported us, these past 5 years have been truly AMAZING, we grew SO MUCH and built something GREAT together.


We leave you with screenshots of the new content, we hope you like it as much as we do.

Cheers from the unstoppable team at Saibot Studios!

Tobías Rusjan

notes.title: Build Update v1.0.3 ⚙️
notes.notes:
Warriors from the Underworld! How are you? :zombie:

Today we have a new update for Hellbound (v1.0.3), which includes a lot of fixes and improvements based on your awesome feedback! You can see the entire changelog below 👇

And we want to take this opportunity to thank our friends at 3ogs (Pablo and Mauricio Navajas), who have been helping us fixing most of the bugs here. You guys rock!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/454f2361d5a6b110a7aac7b0396bea080cdb8f82.png


Among other stuff, we finally finished creating (and adding to the game) the full body statues of our amazing backers from Kickstarter and from our official website 🙌

This is a task we have been doing for the last year and a half. You sent us your idea, we conceptualized it (Fernando Muzzio), then created the final 3D version (by Juan Caratino), and finally added to the game.

All the statues are located inside the level 3 of the campaign: "The Heroes' Cemetery". Some of them are on the surface, others at the coliseum (survival sector), and the rest can only be found in secret rooms...

notes.title: Post-Release QUICK Update! 🏃‍♂️
notes.notes:
Hey everybody in Hell! How's it going?! 😈

We're analyzing all the great feedback you guys are giving us, so we can organize the tasks and then see what we can fix and improve ✍️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31193015/54aeaf01b42bf7a0b1b9e4497c5655a38400f315.jpg

We are well aware of the critiques that have to do with the duration of the campaign.

About that, we can tell you that our idea from the beginning was to make an intense experience that feels like the classic FPSs but putting our full dedication to visuals, audio, and gameplay.That resulted in a few, but SUPER AWESOME, levels that can be completed quickly (even more so because of the pace of the game).

Making more levels was a possibility but that would have resulted in a lower quality experience, and we didn't want that at all.

All in all, be sure that we're reorganizing things and analyzing how everything moves on from this point forward. We’ll be updating you on that soon enough 😉

We thank all of you who have been supporting us and supporting our vision. A big HELLGORE-HUG to you from the dev team at Saibot Studios!

Don't forget to join our Discord! And have a hell of a weekend!

Tobías Rusjan
